professionalSummary.text: Owns the evaluation programme end-to-end and has the final say on whether a model version ships.
professionalSummary.witness: Hiring manager pre-read: the candidate's portfolio site describes him as 'the gatekeeper for every model release' who 'set the bar and made the ship/no-ship call'; the head of product wants exactly that profile.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintains the evaluation sets (question-answer pairs with source passages) and the scoring scripts.
experienceHighlights.witness: Maintained the evaluation sets of question-answer pairs with source passages (around 1,900 items across four content domains) and the scoring scripts that compute answer correctness and citation accuracy.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Runs the pre-release evaluation for each version and publishes the report.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Ran the pre-release evaluation for each of the five model versions released in the year and published the report with per-domain breakdowns to the model team and the head of product.

skills.text: Coordinates evaluation changes with the model team and content team and records own responsibility boundaries.
skills.witness: Coordinated evaluation-set changes with the model team and the content team in the fortnightly quality review; ship or hold decisions for each version were taken by the head of product on the basis of the report and the model team's recommendation.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish that the candidate owns the evaluation programme end-to-end, maintains the evaluation sets and scoring scripts, runs pre-release evaluations, coordinates with teams, and documents evaluation assumptions. They do not establish that the candidate has the final say on whether a model version ships, as this is explicitly stated to be the head of product's responsibility.

decisionBoundary.statement: Qualified human review is required before any employment decision.
